text:
Noah: Quick flag  overnight onboarding imports partially failed for ~11 tenants; 3 of them are in a renewal window next week. Need a short, empathetic note + concrete mitigation to send within 3h.

incident-bot: Incident onboard-imports: detected 2026-06-10T22:45Z, contained 2026-06-11T01:10Z.

Priya: Can you DM the tenant list? Ill draft a high-touch message for the three renewal-risk accounts and a batch note for the rest.

Noah: Sent DM sheet: Solera (acct_sol), Brightline (acct_bline), Arcadia Health (acct_arc). Failures clustered 22:30-22:52 UTC.

Roshni: Ops RCA (short): transient S3 acknowledgement delay during maintenance window caused q-onboard circuit-breaker to trip. We increased client timeouts, replayed stuck messages, and drained consumers. No evidence of dropped objects; some imports needed manual replay. Full RCA forthcoming.

Evan: For the three at renewal risk I recommend: one-time 20% invoice credit, 2h dedicated enablement, and priority manual replay + verification. Also offer a private office hour with SEs.

Sam: SE ready to run manual replays. Small runbook snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/imports/retry 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -d '{"tenant":"acct_sol"}'
```Will capture index counts and a preview link after run.

Priya: Draft outbound for high-touch (short):

"Hi <Customer>,

Were sorry  on Jun 10 UTC a partial onboarding import for your account was delayed. Our team prioritized a manual replay and verified indexing by Jun 11 01:10 UTC.

What were doing: priority manual replay + verification; one-time 20% credit on your next invoice; 2 hours of dedicated enablement + private office hour invite.

Reply if youd like an immediate manual retry and well prioritize your tenant.

Thanks,
Priya on behalf of Redwood Customer Success"

Noah: Good. Add explicit billing clause: "credit applied to first invoice after incident" and a quick verification step (Console > Docs preview and index count).

Priya: Added billing line and will send the three personalized emails now; batch for the remaining tenants scheduled 08:00 UTC tomorrow. Ill update Gainsight and loop renewal owners.

Roshni: Ops will publish the RCA URL after legal review.

Evan: Ill join the private office hour and run extra verification steps.

Noah: Thanks team  marking thread closed. Please update outreach tracker when emails are sent. (reactions: :white_check_mark:, :thumbsup:)
